semesterOne.title: Welcome Week - Computer Science Quiz
description: During welcome week we will be hosting a quiz featuring general knowledge, computing, and logic questions. We will also talk about our plans for the society sessions.

semesterOne.title: Week 1 - Programming Challenges
description: A set of programming challenges that can be completed in any language, but for beginners we recommend python.

semesterOne.title: Week 2 - Command Line Challenge
description: A set of command line challenges. Take part to expand your Linux knowledge and skills.

semesterOne.title: Week 3 - Git Workshop and Challenge
description: A git workshop covering adding, committing, looking at commits, branches, and merging as well as working with remote repositories. The challenge takes you through a directory with issues.
